tokens.usage: Strong dividers, disabled control fill.

tokens.name: gray-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text (via text-muted).

tokens.name: gray-700
tokens.usage: Icons at rest, user-prompt event mark.

tokens.name: gray-800
tokens.usage: Headings in dense views.

tokens.name: gray-900
tokens.usage: Primary text (via text).

tokens.name: gray-950
tokens.usage: Maximum contrast: tooltips ground, kbd keys.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App ground behind panels and the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, tables, the timeline. Default ground for text.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a panel: code blocks, JSON viewer, table header, minimap track.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and item hover on surface.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the command palette, dialogs (with shadow-overlay).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline between rows, card edges, panel dividers. Decorative: no contrast floor.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Section dividers, sticky header bottom edge.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox outlines: at least 3:1 on surface and bg in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-sunken, surface-hover and surface-overlay.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, metadata on every surface (>= 4.5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, units, column headers, on surface and bg (>= 4.5:1). Also the dashed outline of derived content.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on gray-950 (tooltip ground) and on solid status fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, links, selected nav item, focus ring. As text on surface and bg (>= 4.5:1).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active filter chip, current timeline event. accent and text read on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (white in light, near-black in dark).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline with a 2px offset, on every interactive element (>= 3:1 on all surfaces).

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Live / running: text, icon and the pulse dot, on surface and live-soft.

tokens.name: live-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a live badge.

tokens.name: waiting
tokens.usage: Waiting for a human (open gate request): text and icon on surface and waiting-soft; the amber tile edge.

tokens.name: waiting-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a waiting badge and the Needs-you strip items.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Passed / done (bluish green, off the red axis): text and icon on surface and done-soft.

tokens.name: done-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a done badge; diff added-line ground.

tokens.name: failed
tokens.usage: Failed / error: text, icon, the subtle red tile edge, on surface and failed-soft.

tokens.name: failed-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a failed badge, the failure banner; diff removed-line ground.

tokens.name: blocked
tokens.usage: Stopped / blocked (octagon icon): text and icon on surface and blocked-soft.

tokens.name: blocked-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a blocked badge.

tokens.name: idle
tokens.usage: Idle / stale (moon or clock icon): text and icon on surface and idle-soft.

tokens.name: idle-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of idle and stale badges, 'as of' stamps.

tokens.name: guard
tokens.usage: Denied by guard / hook (shield icon): text and icon on surface and guard-soft.

tokens.name: guard-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of guard markers in the timeline.

tokens.name: ev-prompt
tokens.usage: Event mark: user / prompt message.

tokens.name: ev-message
tokens.usage: Event mark: agent message.

tokens.name: ev-reasoning
tokens.usage: Event mark: recorded reasoning summary.

tokens.name: ev-tool
tokens.usage: Event mark: tool call and tool result (ok).

tokens.name: ev-gate
tokens.usage: Event mark: gate request / gate result.

tokens.name: ev-decision
tokens.usage: Event mark: decision (recorded or extracted).

tokens.name: ev-learning
tokens.usage: Event mark: learning proposed / accepted.

tokens.name: ev-lifecycle
tokens.usage: Event mark: session start / end, resume, late enrichment.

tokens.usage: Removed-line ground.

styles.usage: Money, tokens, durations and counts in tables (tabular, right-aligned).

spacing.note: 4px grid. Gaps inside a component use 1-3; between components 4-6; between page sections 8+.

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Timeline lane indent for one nested subagent level.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-16
